reason: The case requires XML-producing queries and, in its second function, consumption of a custom-generator stream<Book, error?>. Although the query clauses, XML templates, classes and new expressions are listed, stream construction/iteration and stream-backed query behavior are not covered by subset10. That essential uncovered behavior makes the whole case a feature request; the negative type-checking assertions do not by themselves put supported syntax out of scope.
unsupported_constructs: Custom-generator stream<Book, error?> construction and stream-backed XML query evaluation/type checking
test_design_notes: Mixed scope: readonly XML query result rejection checks are combined with custom-generator stream queries.
One stream query assignment (xml:Text|xml) has no @error marker, while neighboring stream query assignments do; preserve this intentional-looking positive/negative mixture when splitting the test.
No @args, @panic or @output markers occur. The XML sequence interpolation restriction is not triggered: the templates interpolate record string fields, not query results.
